topic: Science Solutions to Local Environmental Issues
key_concepts: Environmental issues in the local community can be identified and addressed by science
Treatment of waste is one way science addresses environmental issues
Properties of materials can be applied to solve environmental problems
Proposed solutions should be verified through simple research
Collaboration with peers helps develop possible solutions to environmental issues
Doable solutions are selected based on learners' capabilities
Solutions can be communicated through letters, songs, poems, posters, or diagrams
Environmental stewardship means taking care of nature
Plastic pollution harms animals and makes the planet dirty
Consumption is using up things like food, toys, or energy
Plastic footprint is how much plastic is used in daily life
Deforestation, biodiversity loss, and single-use plastics are environmental concerns
